title: ESC serial passthrough on GPIO 2 (19200 8N1)
about: esc_serial.pio: the 4-way passthrough wire, half duplex: bytes out, one guard bit, the line released, the ESC's answer received. The ESC is scripted (a reply shaped like a BLHeli bootloader BootInfo; illustrative, not a BLHeli implementation). 27 MHz system clock.
